zero_state: Construct an explicitly zero-filled sex-by-age state, including AD scalars whose default constructor does not initialize a numerical zero.
cell: Map zero-based sex and age to the flattened 32-cell population-state index; callers supply sex 0-1 and age 0-15.
State: Fixed 2-sex by 16-age abundance array. Cells are thousands of fish; age 15 is the plus group.
Dimensions: Assessment calendar, four seasonal durations, spawning month, area count and plus-group age.
Fleet: One-based fleet identity, type, observation timing, catch units, multiplier flag and source name.
Catch: One observed fleet-season catch with year, value and log-scale standard error; fleet units select tonnes or thousands of fish.
Index: Abundance-index observation and inclusion flag with source month, fleet, positive observation and log standard error.
Composition: Length-composition sample, inclusion flag, sex/partition coding, sample size and both source blocks of 51 bins.
Parameter: Named SS3 control specification, original numeric columns and source line for provenance.
Growth: Sex-specific von Bertalanffy reference ages/lengths, coefficient of variation and length-weight coefficients.
Biology: Fixed natural mortality, sex-specific growth, maturity, sex allocation and settlement settings.
InputData: Complete supported swordfish observation and control schema; unsupported SS3 variants are rejected rather than approximated silently.
InputData::validate: Check supported dimensions, season durations, mortality, fleet/catch definitions and growth before evaluating the imported data.
exposure: Calculate the stable Baranov exposure (1-exp(-Z*duration))/Z, using a near-zero expansion; Z is an annual rate and duration is years.
SeasonResult: Seasonal survivors, natural deaths and fleet catch numbers, all on the same thousands-of-fish scale as the starting state.
advance_season: Apply natural and fleet fishing mortality over a fraction of a year, returning survivors and separately attributed removals without altering the input state.
age_on_january_first: Advance survivors one age at the calendar-year boundary, retain accumulated ages in the plus group and clear age zero.
settle: Mutate age-zero abundance by adding recruitment allocated to females and males using the supplied female fraction.
spawning_biomass: Calculate female mature biomass after survival to a calendar-correct within-season spawning time.
spawning_biomass_ss33020: Reproduce the legacy SS3 v3.30.20 spawning-survival timing convention used by the supplied benchmark, deliberately distinct from the calendar-correct helper.
mean_length: Evaluate the ordinary von Bertalanffy growth curve at a real age using fixed growth settings and length at birth.
beverton_holt: Return expected recruitment from spawning biomass, virgin recruitment, virgin spawning biomass and steepness; retain scalar-generic derivatives.
ParameterValues: Map canonical parameter names to native values of a common scalar type.
initial_values: Populate a parameter map from control initial values; these may differ from fitted Report.sso values.
logistic: Calculate a numerically stable inverse-logit for ordinary or AD scalars.
normal_cdf: Approximate the standard normal CDF with scalar-generic operations, enabling differentiation through age-length probabilities.
length_probabilities: Integrate normal lengths across lower-edge bins, accumulating the two tails in the end bins and rejecting invalid grids or scale.
length_at_age: Calculate sex-specific mean length with the supplied birth timing, seasonal growth and SS3 plus-group growth adjustment.
length_sd: Interpolate age-dependent length variability and convert its coefficient of variation to a standard deviation.
age_length_key: Return bin probabilities for one sex, age and within-year time using fitted growth parameters.
length_midpoint: Map a population length-bin lower edge to its integration midpoint, including the final bin convention.
weight_at_length: Evaluate the sex-specific length-weight power relationship; length is cm and individual weight is kg.
weight_at_age: Integrate individual weight over the age-length key at a supplied within-year time.
maturity_at_length: Evaluate the length-based logistic female maturity curve from its midpoint and slope.
maturity_integration_time: Locate the start of the subseason containing spawning, matching the supplied SS3 maturity integration convention.
mature_weight_at_age: Integrate mature female biomass contribution across length bins, respecting the first mature age.
selectivity_period: Build a discrete block-activity cache key for a year; use only within one evaluation to avoid reusing AD tape vertices.
effective_selectivity_parameter: Resolve a fleet selectivity parameter with year-specific replacement blocks and canonical parameter mapping.
length_selectivity: Build fleet length-selectivity curves for supported constant, logistic, double-normal and mirror patterns, including active blocks.
SelectedAge: Integrated selectivity in numbers and biomass, with selected mean length and weight for a sex/age cell.
selected_at_age: Integrate fleet length selectivity and weight over an age-length key to obtain selected-at-age summary quantities.
Deviations: Map recruitment years to fitted log recruitment deviations, including early age-structure deviations.
SeasonalBiology: Per-season selected numbers, selected weight, beginning weights and mature weights for mortality and biomass calculations.
seasonal_biology: Integrate growth, selectivity and mature weight for one of four seasons; produce all fleet/sex/age factors needed by population dynamics.
fishing_at_age: Multiply fleet apical annual fishing rates by numbers selectivity to obtain fleet-specific sex/age mortality arrays.
HybridResult: Hybrid-catch solution containing fleet apical rates, predicted catches and mortality-at-age arrays.
HybridResult::HybridResult<T>: Explicitly initialize accumulated catch and apical-rate scalars to numerical zero, including AD types.
hybrid_catch: Reproduce SS3 method-3 finite catch tuning, including Pope initialization, smooth caps, mixed catch units and the configured finite adjustment count.
recruitment_bias: Evaluate the piecewise recruitment-bias ramp for a historical year from the advanced control settings.
adjusted_recruitment: Apply a year's fitted deviation and log-bias correction to expected recruitment without changing the deviation map.
seasonal_ssb: Combine beginning numbers, fishing mortality and mature weights to compute spawning biomass under SS3 v3.30.20 timing.
Equilibrium: Per-season beginning population states, equilibrium recruitment and spawning biomass for constant seasonal mortality.
equilibrium: Solve the stationary seasonal sex/age population for supplied fishing rates and recruitment, including July settlement and the plus group.
InitialPopulation: Virgin and initially fished equilibria plus January starting abundance after early recruitment deviations.
initialize_population: Calculate virgin and initial-fishing Beverton-Holt equilibria, then apply early deviations and bias correction to the initial age structure.
PopulationSeason: One historical season's beginning and midpoint abundance, hybrid catch, removals, recruitment and biomass summaries.
PopulationRun: Historical seasonal trajectory and its virgin/initial equilibrium provenance.
run_population: Run all historical seasons from original catches and native parameters, recalculating recruitment and caching biology within this evaluation only.
likelihood_weight: Resolve a component/fleet likelihood lambda at the requested estimation phase.
variance_adjustment: Apply a parsed variance adjustment for an observation kind and fleet to its initial error value.
population_row: Return a checked reference to one historical year-season row; reject missing or out-of-range calendar positions.
ObservationTime: Resolved season, within-year observation time, age-length-key time and elapsed seasonal survival duration.
observation_time: Translate a source observation month and fleet timing setting into the season and exposure times used for index and composition prediction.
LengthKeys: Sex-specific cached age-length keys for a single within-year time in one likelihood evaluation.
sampled_lengths: Project selected surviving numbers into sex-specific sampled length frequencies for an observation time.
profiled_log_q: Analytically profile log catchability as an inverse-variance-weighted log residual mean, using the exact source stabilization.
lognormal_index_nll: Evaluate the index lognormal negative log-likelihood under the configured standard-deviation offset convention.
multinomial_deviance: Calculate sample-size-weighted multinomial composition deviance against a perfect-fit offset after probability stabilization.
stabilized_catch_nll: Evaluate SS3's stabilized log catch residual penalty for observed and predicted fleet-unit catch.
selectivity_soft_bounds: Evaluate the supported symmetric-beta soft-bound penalty on estimated selectivity parameters.
recruitment_nll: Sum squared historical log recruitment deviations and the bias-weighted log-sigma contribution for the joint likelihood target.
IndexFit: Index observation prediction, profiled catchability, residual, error and unweighted likelihood contribution.
LengthFit: Length-sample prediction and diagnostics, including effective sample size, observed/predicted means and deviance.
LikelihoodResult: Joint objective total, named weighted components, fitted indices and included length-sample diagnostics.
evaluate_likelihood: Calculate catch, index, length-composition, recruitment and soft-bound components from a population trajectory; preserve all configured lambdas.
SwordfishModel: Quadra model adapter for the 84-coordinate joint penalized-likelihood target; historical recruitment deviations are optimized, not Laplace-integrated.
SwordfishModel::FreeParameter: One independent fitting coordinate: canonical name, native bounds/value and optional recruitment year.
SwordfishModel::SwordfishModel: Build the fitting-coordinate schema from estimated control parameters and independent early/main recruitment deviations.
SwordfishModel::parameter_names_impl: Return canonical names in the same order as fitting coordinates and covariance matrices.
SwordfishModel::initial_vector: Transform interior native starting values to bounded-logit coordinates and reject starts at or beyond bounds.
SwordfishModel::initial_parameters: Create Quadra's parameter vector, treating every independent coordinate as a joint optimized parameter.
SwordfishModel::decode: Transform fitting coordinates to native parameters/deviations and enforce the zero-sum main-deviation constraint, including the dependent final year.
SwordfishModel::likelihood: Decode coordinates, run the population and return the complete component-wise likelihood result.
SwordfishModel::operator(): Return only the joint scalar objective for a supplied fitting-coordinate vector.
SwordfishModel::evaluate_impl: Evaluate the scalar objective through Quadra's model interface and register it in the report context.
BenchmarkResult: Fishing multiplier, raw SPR, SSB in tonnes, recruitment in thousands, dead yield in tonnes and pooled annual F for one equilibrium.
Benchmarks: Equilibrium reference-point calculator holding selected historical fleet/season fishing proportions and terminal biology.
Benchmarks::Benchmarks: Construct terminal biology and virgin per-recruit biomass, and average the requested historical fishing-pattern years.
Benchmarks::operator(): Solve positive Beverton-Holt recruitment, equilibrium abundance, yield and SS3 units-4 annual F for a nonnegative fishing multiplier.
Benchmarks::target: Use bracket expansion and bisection to find a valid fractional SPR or virgin-biomass target.
Benchmarks::msy: Find maximum equilibrium yield through a bracketed fourth-order numerical derivative root, avoiding flat-objective rounding noise.
dynamic_unfished: Rerun historical dynamics with all catch and initial fishing removed, retaining recruitment deviations, bias adjustment and counterfactual spawning feedback.
ProjectionRow: One projected year's SSB, expected recruitment, January biomass, dead yield and realized pooled annual F.
FishingPattern: Four seasons by 19 fleets of annual apical fishing rates.
mean_fishing_pattern: Average fitted fleet/season apical rates over checked historical reference years.
historical_spr: Calculate raw per-recruit SPR using that historical year's fishing rates and selectivity blocks.
annual_f_units4: Calculate pooled numbers-weighted annual F over ages 1-10 from January and end-year abundance, matching SS3 units 4.
terminal_biology: Construct all four seasonal biological factors under terminal-year selectivity.
project: Advance a January state through deterministic future seasons at constant apical fishing rates, with BH expected recruitment and no future process deviations.
ProjectionScenario: Parsed scenario identifier, target rule, value and reference-year window for the supported ten-year forecast.
read_projection_scenarios: Read and validate exactly five unquoted scenario records, rejecting malformed numeric tokens, duplicate names and unsupported targets/reference years.
check_projection_selectivity: Reject unsupported assessment dimensions and changes among 2019-2021 selectivity curves before using a common terminal curve.
ResolvedScenario: Scenario definition paired with its recalculated numerical target and equilibrium fishing solution.
resolve_projection_scenarios: Recalculate dynamic-baseline, historical-SPR, SPR, MSY and status-quo targets from a fitted history and solve their fishing multipliers.
ScenarioProjection: Resolved scenario and its complete deterministic annual forecast trajectory.
evaluate_projection_scenarios: Rebuild historical state, dynamic baseline, fishing mixture, targets and all five forecasts for one native parameter/deviation pair.
csv_line: Read a single line while normalizing CRLF record endings; report normal end-of-stream without inventing a record.
csv_fields: Split the explicit unquoted CSV dialect while preserving trailing empty fields; quoted and multiline fields are rejected.
csv_integer: Parse one entire decimal integer token; reject blank, overflowing or suffixed values.
csv_number: Parse one entire finite decimal floating-point token; reject whitespace, nonfinite values, invalid characters and range errors.
validate_parameter_covariance: Require a nonempty finite, symmetric, positive-definite parameter covariance before propagation; do not regularize silently.
delta_covariance: Propagate a compatible finite output Jacobian through the full parameter covariance as J V J-transpose, preserving correlations.
PositiveInterval: Native standard error and positive lower/upper pointwise log-scale Wald endpoints.
positive_delta_interval: Construct a pointwise positive 95% interval from a positive estimate and nonnegative native variance; reject nonfinite results.
read_reference_parameters: Read versioned SS3 fitted-value/deviation fixtures with exact mapping, counts and finite values; retain the report/control distinction.
read_fitted_parameters: Read a complete native fitted CSV using strict numeric parsing and canonical recruitment-deviation names; reject unknown, duplicate or missing rows.
write_fitted_outputs: Write historical trajectories, fitted observations, likelihood components and management reference points for the supplied fitted model state. Every fit/report caller receives the same derived-output calculation; release publication is handled separately.
src/audit_dynamics.cpp::Check: Accumulate finite benchmark comparison counts and worst absolute/tolerance-scaled errors for this audit.
src/audit_dynamics.cpp::Check::compare: Compare one finite model/reference pair using absolute plus relative tolerance, updating the audit summary.
src/audit_dynamics.cpp::read: Read one typed comparison-fixture token and throw if the fixture is truncated or malformed.
src/audit_likelihood.cpp::Check: Accumulate finite benchmark comparison counts and worst absolute/tolerance-scaled errors for this audit.
src/audit_likelihood.cpp::Check::compare: Compare one finite model/reference pair using absolute plus relative tolerance, updating the audit summary.
src/audit_likelihood.cpp::read: Read one typed comparison-fixture token and throw if the fixture is truncated or malformed.
src/audit_population.cpp::Check: Accumulate finite benchmark comparison counts and worst absolute/tolerance-scaled errors for this audit.
src/audit_population.cpp::Check::compare: Compare one finite model/reference pair using absolute plus relative tolerance, updating the audit summary.
src/audit_population.cpp::read: Read one typed comparison-fixture token and throw if the fixture is truncated or malformed.
src/audit_biology.cpp::Result: Biology audit accumulator storing counts, worst errors and the context of the worst comparison.
src/audit_biology.cpp::Result::check: Validate one finite biological prediction, updating absolute and tolerance-scaled errors and worst-case context.
src/summarize_curvature.cpp::split: Split a generated Hessian/coordinate record into comma-delimited fields for curvature summarization.
src/summarize_curvature.cpp::load: Load a square generated Hessian by labeled perturbation rows and gradient columns, checking row/header correspondence.
src/swordfish_diagnostics.cpp::RescaledM: Constant linear coordinate adapter using the fitted covariance Cholesky factor; the likelihood and native bounds are unchanged.
Store the underlying model, fitted coordinate center and constant linear rescaling matrix.
Return the underlying model coordinate names in unchanged order.
Map rescaled optimizer coordinates back to original bounded-logit coordinates as center plus factor times displacement.
Evaluate the original joint objective after the constant coordinate transformation.
Provide the rescaled joint objective through the Quadra model evaluation interface.
src/swordfish_projection_uncertainty.cpp: One labeled scenario-year-quantity point estimate, with a unique covariance/Jacobian output identifier.
Flatten all scenario trajectories into a stable 250-output order shared by intervals, Jacobian rows and covariance labels.
control_start_values: Return literal control native values and zero historical recruitment deviations. An explicit matched-fixed sensitivity changes only male L1 from 83.2 to 83.4; no fitted free parameters or report values are read.
ControlStartPhase: Active-coordinate view of the independent control-start model. Inactive coordinates remain at its checkpoint; the optional catch-only objective is a documented feasibility stage for an otherwise undefined full likelihood.
ControlStartPhase::ControlStartPhase: Select independent coordinates using original control activation phases: 1, 8, 64 and 84 active values. Early deviations activate in phase 4 and main deviations in phase 3.
ControlStartPhase::parameter_names_impl: Return the active canonical coordinate labels in unchanged full-model order.
ControlStartPhase::expand: Expand active values into the complete bounded-logit vector while preserving all inactive checkpoint coordinates.
ControlStartPhase::operator(): Evaluate the same final weighted joint target, or catch-only feasibility when explicitly enabled. Neither path reads SS3 estimates or saved covariance.
ControlStartPhase::evaluate_impl: Expose the restricted scalar objective through the public Quadra model evaluation interface.
src/swordfish_control_start.cpp::ColdMet: Linear optimizer coordinate map learned by differentiating the cold trajectory only. Spectral regularization applies to optimization scaling and is not an inferential covariance or a changed statistical target.
Borrow the cold objective and copy its current coordinate center and constant scaling factor.
Preserve canonical coordinate ordering when applying cold-learned scaling.
Map scaled displacements to the original bounded-logit coordinates as center plus factor times displacement.
Evaluate the unchanged full joint objective after cold-derived numerical scaling.
Provide the scaled objective through the Quadra model interface.
src/swordfish_control_start.cpp::save_pa: Write all native parameters and 57 recruitment deviations to a distinct control-start checkpoint or final result CSV.
management_reference_points: Calculate unfished, Btgt20, SPR20 and MSY derived outputs from supplied fitted parameters and deviations using terminal biology and terminal-year fishing mixture. No SS3 reference values enter these calculations.
SwordfishModel::reference_points: Decode the model coordinate vector with the likelihood constraints and return its standard equilibrium management reference points as post-fit derived outputs.
write_reference_points: Write the standard independently calculated management reference-point table for the supplied fitted state; reject nonfinite values and propagate output failures.
native_number: Read one finite numeric value from the versioned native transport; reject invalid or truncated tokens.
native_count: Read and bound a native collection length before allocating model data.
native_array: Read a statically sized numeric array from the typed native stream.
native_vector: Read a length-prefixed finite numeric vector from native transport.
native_table: Read a length-prefixed fixed-width numeric settings table.
read_native_input: Read the complete native model data and explicit historical deviations without generated factories or SS3 fixtures; validate finite values, counts, constraints and supported dimensions.
LocalCurvature: Full independent-coordinate covariance from validated local curvature, with a second-step covariance and numerical diagnostics.
validated_local_curvature: Validate two finite-difference Hessians for finite values, symmetry, step stability and positive definiteness, then invert without regularization and check SE stability.
ReferenceEstimate: One flattened management reference-point quantity, native units, point estimate and proportion-interval flag.
reference_estimates: Flatten all six quantities for each of four model reference points; enforce known structural zeros and target proportions to avoid numerical root noise.
write_uncertainty_matrix: Write a finite, dimension-checked labeled matrix with all coordinate/output correlations retained.
write_reference_point_uncertainty: Compute fresh two-step AD-gradient curvature and two-step reference-point Jacobians, propagate the full covariance, and write validated SEs, CVs and 95% local intervals without SS3 files or saved covariance.
NumericLengthKeys: Ordinary double-valued sex/age/length probabilities for a single within-year time; no AD tape state.
FixedBiology: Evaluation-scoped numeric biology workspace shared by population and observations. Owns the parameter snapshot, borrows input data, and disables itself conservatively when biology is estimated.
FixedBiology::FixedBiology: Check biological estimation flags before precomputing ordinary length weights and mature weights; no cross-evaluation AD state is retained.
FixedBiology::enabled: Report whether all biological dependencies are fixed and the numeric workspace was requested.
FixedBiology::length_keys: Calculate each time-specific sex/age/length probability table once within this evaluation; reject use when biological parameters are estimated.
FixedBiology::weights_at_age: Calculate individual beginning-season weights once per within-year time for fixed biological settings.
tests/test_fixed_biology.cpp::compare_pa: Compare the full cached and original objectives and all coordinate gradients at the same model state, using the original equations as the validation oracle.
